title: Checkout is still spinning
label: ASHA'S CHECKOUT
voice: Asha taps Place Order during a sale. Checkout keeps spinning, then times out. Her payment may already have succeeded.
note: A timeout is not proof of failure.

title: Cheap waiting is not extra capacity
label: WHAT VIRTUAL THREADS CHANGE
voice: Java twenty one virtual threads make blocking waits cheaper. They do not make the payment provider faster.
note: Efficient waiting does not add database connections.

title: The queue moves downstream
label: THE REAL BOTTLENECK
voice: Five hundred waiting requests cannot use a database pool with twenty connections at once. The queue simply moves downstream.

title: One durable payment identity
label: MAKE RETRIES PAYMENT-SAFE
voice: First, save one durable payment attempt. Repeated clicks reuse the same reference. Never create another charge just because checkout timed out.
note: Reject the same key with a different request payload.

title: Bound calls and waiting work
label: BULKHEAD + BACKPRESSURE
voice: Then bound active calls and waiting work. A bulkhead protects the provider. Work not started gets an honest busy response.
note: A local semaphore is not a global provider quota.

title: UNKNOWN needs reconciliation
label: REAL DEADLINES · HONEST STATUS
voice: Set real network deadlines. If payment is uncertain, keep the original reference and reconcile. A timeout is not proof of cancellation.
note: Do not blindly authorize or capture a second payment.

title: A reliable checkout outcome
label: CUSTOMER PROTECTED
voice: Now checkout reports a reliable status. Virtual threads improve waiting efficiency. Capacity limits, backpressure and payment safe recovery protect the customer.
note: Short transactions · bounded capacity · safe recovery
